what: float64 Gram matrix K = J J^T of fourth-order PDE residual gradients over every weight, bias and readout parameter of deep tanh MLPs u(t, x) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 (t, x) + b_1) ...) + bo on R^(1 + D) (D = space coordinates), with an initial-condition block, and the damped Gauss-Newton step: gram = (r, K); gn = (0.5 |r|^2, step). Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_gram with fourth-order blocks: the bi-Laplacian streams (value, k gradients, q drift tangents, packed Hessian, Laplacian, its k gradients, bi-Laplacian; T = 1 + k + q + k (k + 1) / 2 + 1 + k + 1 per point) carry the cotangents of every pre-activation stream; per hidden layer and block pair <dr_b / dW, dr_c / dW> = sum_(t,s) (P_b^T P_c)_ts (Q_b^T Q_c)_ts or explicit rows by a rule with constant 1.2 (the second-order rule keeps 2.2). The claim regime rho = H / (T (T + 1)) >= 3 (the identity pays where the width is large against the number of stream pairs; T = 7, 11, 16 at D = 1, 2, 3) was set on separate calibration cells; cells with rho < 3 are controls. Controls: explicit rows from the same streams, vmap(grad) through the package's one-point fourth-order path and through an independent forward bi-Laplacian recursion, nested folx forward Laplacians, Taylor mode along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions, nested autodiff; the identity-on-every-layer tier is an ablation of the per-layer rule. The package's one-point path (vmap_pkg) ran at one space coordinate and aborted the worker (segmentation fault in the XLA compile) at every D >= 2 program, so the per-row bi-Laplacian tier is partial (its ratio is taken against the independent recursion); nested autodiff ran out of memory in one cell
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's gram and gn programs on a reduced instance (width 4, D_q = min(D, 3) space coordinates, B = 4 interior rows and 1 initial row, same depth and operator, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (fourth-order series along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions, J by central differences in every parameter, step by an LU solve in 50 digits): r and K 1e-12 + 1e-10 max |ref|, loss 1e-12 + 1e-10 |ref|, step 1e-12 + 1e-8 max |ref|; the candidate passes both under the rule and with the identity forced on every hidden layer; full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.explicit_rows_from_shared_streams: the same fourth-order streams and cotangents with every hidden-layer gradient formed explicitly, strategy = explicit, pkg_rows
tiers.per_row_forward_bilaplacian: vmap(grad) through the package's one-point projected_deep_bilaplacian, vmap_pkg, and through an independent forward bi-Laplacian recursion, fbl_lib
tiers.per_row_nested_forward_laplacian: vmap(grad) through nested folx forward Laplacians, folx2
tiers.taylor_mode: vmap(grad) through jax.experimental.jet along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions
tiers.nested_autodiff: vmap(grad) through nested jax.hessian traces, D <= 3 space coordinates
tiers.identity_every_layer: ablation: the identity forced on every hidden layer, no per-layer rule

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning
